items.h: Aaron Rodgers Unlikely to Play Again this Season After Clearing Waivers
items.s: Former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers is unlikely to play again this season after clearing waivers on Thursday, per Tom Pelissero of The Ringer. Pelissero reports that "no immediate suitors" emerged for Rodgers, and that "barring an injury-driven emergency," league sources expect teams to remain uninterested. Rodgers was released by Pittsburgh earlier this week after a dispute with team leadership. The 42-year-old then took his grievances to the media, airing out a number of issues he had with Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on ESPN. Outside of character-related concerns, Rodgers has not played well this season, averaging a career-low 6.2 yards per…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers clears waivers
items.s: Aaron Rodgers has cleared waivers. Rodgers is now officially a free agent. It is unclear if a QB needy team will take a chance on him.

items.h: Goes unclaimed on waivers
items.s: Rodgers went unclaimed on waivers and is now a free agent, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports. Rodgers went on waivers after being cut loose by the Steelers on Thursday, and no team elected to claim him and the $8.56 million remaining on his contract. Rodgers is now able to sign with any team, but it's unclear what his next move will be.

items.h: Cut loose by Pittsburgh
items.s: The Steelers waived Rodgers on Wednesday. After announcing late Tuesday that Rodgers had been demoted from the starting role, the Steelers formally cut ties with him a day later following his critical comments of head coach Mike McCarthy during an interview on "The Pat McAfee Show." Rodgers will now be subject to waivers, where any team putting in a claim for him would have to assume the approximately $8.6 million remaining on his contract. According to Dianna Russini of BetUS TV, no teams have currently expressed interest in claiming Rodgers or signing him once he clears waivers, perhaps bringing an unceremonious end to the four-time league MVP's storied career. Rodgers, who previously…

items.h: Set to be waived
items.s: The Steelers plan to waive Rodgers once his contract situation is finalized, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz. After deciding late Tuesday to name Mason Rudolph as their new starting quarterback heading into Friday's game versus the Broncos, the Steelers had planned to make Rodgers inactive for Week 12 but keep him around in the organization, per Ian Rapoport of NFL Network. However, those plans changed Wednesday, shortly after Rodgers made an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" during which he was highly critical of head coach Mike McCarthy's leadership. Rodgers' comments have now hastened his departure from Pittsburgh, but Schultz relays that the Steelers still have to determine…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers released by Steelers
items.s: The Steelers released QB Aaron Rodgers. This news comes within an hour after Rodgers went onto the Pat McAfee airing out information on Mike McCarthy and his time being with him in Pittsburgh and Green Bay. Aaron Rodgers had said entering this year that this would be his final season. It is unclear what will be next for him.

items.h: No intention to stay with Steelers
items.s: Rodgers said Wednesday during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" that he has no plans to remain with the Steelers after the team announced Tuesday that Mason Rudolph would replace him as the starting quarterback for Week 12, ESPN.com reports. "At this point, I'm not going back to Pittsburgh," Rodgers said. "That ship has sailed." In a lengthy interview, Rodgers expressed his dissatisfaction with head coach Mike McCarthy and acknowledged that his criticism of the coach would spell the end to his two-year run in Pittsburgh. As Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com points out, Rodgers has approximately $8.6 million guaranteed remaining on his salary, but the Steelers could cite his comments on "The…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers not heading back to Steelers
items.s: Aaron Rodgers has said he is not heading back to the Steelers. While not reported yet, this is about as clear an indication as any that Drew Allar is the backup in Pittsburgh. Rodgers was benched late Tuesday night and Rodgers has since gone on the Pat MacAfee show detailing some of the drama in Pittsburgh, that culminated in his benching and him leaving the team. He might still find a home elsewhere, given he hasn't "retired" as of yet, but his time in Pittsburgh is over.

items.h: Not at facility Wednesday morning
items.s: Rodgers was not at the Steelers' facility Wednesday morning and "it's unclear if he will show up at all" during the day, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports. The Steelers announced late Tuesday night that Mason Rudolph would start Friday's game against the Broncos and that Rodgers would be inactive for the same contest, and Rodgers is seemingly none too pleased with the decision. Per Gerry Dulac of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette, the situation been "brewing for a while" and "reached the point of no return" following the late-night announcement, leaving Rodgers' future with the Steelers uncertain.

items.h: Absent from team facility Wednesday
items.s: Rodgers wasn't present at the Steelers' facility Wednesday morning and isn't expected to participate in practice, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz. The Steelers announced late Tuesday that Mason Rudolph would start Friday's game against the Broncos and that Rodgers would be inactive for the same contest, and according to Adam Schefter of ESPN, the Steelers excused the veteran signal-caller to give him some time to process his benching. Per Gerry Dulac of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette, the situation been "brewing for a while" and "reached the point of no return" following the late-night announcement, leaving Rodgers' future with the Steelers uncertain.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers to be benched in Week 12
items.s: The Steelers are benching Aaron Rodgers for Friday's game against the Broncos. Pelissero notes that this was a coaches decision. Mason Rudolph will start for Pittsburgh on Friday.

items.h: Benched by Pittsburgh
items.s: Rodgers has been benched by the Steelers, and Mason Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports. Additionally, Rodgers will be inactive against Denver. It's a stunning late Tuesday night announcement, but the Steelers' playoff chances have taken a hit following back-to-back losses to the Bengals and Eagles, dropping Pittsburgh to 6-4 on the season. Rodgers has been particularly dreadful in both games, completing 45 of 73 passes for 370 yards (5.1 YPA) and three touchdowns. Losing to an Eagles team that was starting Joe Milton proved to be the final straw for coach Mike McCarthy, who will turn things over to Rudolph. Rodgers has…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Benched by Steelers, Will be Inactive on Friday
items.s: The Pittsburgh Steelers have benched veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers, and he will not be active for the Black Friday game in Week 12 against the visiting Denver Broncos, according to Cameron Wolfe of the NFL Network. Mason Rudolph will make his first start of the season against Denver on Friday. It is a huge change for Pittsburgh, as their playoff position is in peril due to their offensive struggles. The Ringer's Tom Pelissero says that the future Hall of Famer might have played the final snap of his legendary 22-year career. The Steelers are now 6-4 after back-to-back losses to the Cincinnati Bengals and Philadelphia Eagles, and Rodgers has been very mediocre in what is expected to be…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Still a Viable Streaming Option
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers has had a relatively mediocre 2026 campaign as it relates to fantasy football. He has completed 220 out of 361 passing attempts (60.9%) for 2,241 yards, 16 touchdowns, and six interceptions. According to RotoBaller, he ranks as the 17th quarterback in 2026 in total fantasy points scored (148.7) and 21st in fantasy points per game (14.9). Most recently, Rodgers threw 44 times, completing 30 of those passes (68.2%), for 227 yards and a touchdown in a Week 11 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles. Rodgers added 29 rushing yards against the Eagles. Rodgers faces a Denver Broncos defense in Week 12 that has struggled to defend the pass, allowing…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers leads Steelers in rush yards in Week 11's loss
items.s: Aaron Rodgers went 30/44 for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. He added five rushes for 29 yards. The almost 43-year-old Rodgers becomes the second-oldest player in NFL history to lead his team in rush yards, only trailing Tom Brady. After a four-game stretch of 11 passing touchdowns, Rodgers has now totaled four in his last four games. Rodgers faces a tough Denver defense on Sunday, where he holds no more than QB2 value.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Remains Steelers' Starting Quarterback
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers will remain the starter, head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday when asked if he'd considered using another quarterback, according to Nick Farabaugh. I'd sit Rodgers in one-quarterback leagues and use him as a Superflex fallback for Friday's Week 12 home game against the Denver Broncos. Rodgers threw for 227 yards and a touchdown on 44 attempts in Sunday's loss to the Philadelphia Eagles, his busiest passing day since Week 6. He's averaged just 5.1 yards per attempt and taken eight sacks over Pittsburgh's last two games. Denver sacked Fernando Mendoza five times Sunday, and Rodgers could face that pass rush without his most-targeted receiver. NFL…

items.h: Struggles again in Week 11 loss
items.s: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles. Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman on Pittsburgh's final offensive play with 1:21 remaining in the fourth quarter, but that was too little too late, as the Eagles proceeded to run out the clock to drop the Steelers to 6-4. Hurleman stepped up down the stretch in his first NFL game after starting wide receiver DK Metcalf was disqualified. Rodgers had a four-game stretch in which he threw 11 touchdown passes while posting at least 235 passing yards in each outing, but he has failed to reach that yardage total in any of his last four…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Could Get Added Weapons in Week 11
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers came through for fantasy purposes last week, largely in garbage time, during a blowout loss to the Cincinnati Bengals. He'll hope to put together a steadier performance in Week 11 against the Philadelphia Eagles. The Eagles have struggled against opposing quarterbacks this season, allowing the ninth-most fantasy points per game to the position. Furthermore, Rodgers may have additional weapons available on Sunday, with Roman Wilson (hand) and Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) practicing in full on Thursday and Friday. Still, it's difficult to get excited about Rodgers' potential in this contest, which is projected to be the lowest-scoring affair of the…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Retains Streaming Value Despite Some Week 10 Struggles
items.s: Pittsburgh quarterback Aaron Rodgers struggled a bit in Week 10, but he remains a solid deep-league starting option and someone to consider streaming in standard leagues. Against Cincinnati this past week, Rodgers was 15-of-29 passing for 143 yards and two touchdowns, and he avoided an interception - he didn't add anything on the ground. He's now completing just 59.9% of his passes on the season, but he's thrown for 223.8 yards per game and has 15 touchdowns to six interceptions, so Rodgers still has some fantasy appeal. He is an option in Week 11, when six teams are on their bye weeks. He's delivered enough this season to trust, especially in a pretty favorable fantasy matchup in Week 11…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers tosses two touchdowns in loss Sunday
items.s: Aaron Rodgers completed 15-of-29 passing attempts for 143 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals. The Steelers weren't able to get it done on Sunday night, suffering a big loss at the hands of the Bengals. Rodgers had a decent performance in that game with two touchdowns and no turnovers, but he still made his fair share of mistakes and wasn't able to lead the offense to many points scored. Moving forward he should continue to be regarded as nothing more than a streaming option for fantasy purposes.

items.h: Two more TD passes
items.s: Rodgers completed 15 of 29 passes for 143 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed two times for minus-1 yard during Sunday's 38-18 loss at Cincinnati. The Steelers sat at 33 total yards of offense after three quarters, so the vast majority of Rodgers' output occurred on the team's three fourth-quarter possessions, two of which ended in touchdown connections with WR DK Metcalf (22 yards) and TE Pat Freiermuth (27 yards). Through nine games this season, Rodgers has tossed multiple TDs on five occasions, but he's also been held to less than 200 yards through the air three times. Rodgers will seek better results next Sunday in Phildadelphia.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers on Fantasy Radar in AFC North Showdown
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers will return from a Week 9 bye to take on the division-rival Cincinnati Bengals in Week 10. When Rodgers last faced Cincinnati in Week 3, he finished as a top-10 fantasy QB with 292 passing yards, three touchdowns, and one interception. Although he'll be on the road this time, the Bengals remain a relatively favorable matchup, surrendering 229 passing yards and over 28 points per game to opposing offenses at home. Unlike most AFC North battles, this contest is expected to be high-scoring, with a projected point total of around 49.5. The Steelers have won their last few games behind a strong running game, but Rodgers will likely need to throw…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Offers Streaming Upside in Week 10 Matchup
items.s: Pittsburgh quarterback Aaron Rodgers carries some streaming appeal for his Week 10 matchup against Cincinnati. It's a pretty average matchup for a fantasy quarterback, but we've already seen this matchup once this season, and Rodgers delivered big in that contest. Back in Week 3, Rodgers completed 19 of his 34 passes for 292 yards and three touchdowns. He was picked off once, and he finished with a season-high 10 rushing yards on three attempts. He's completed just 60.8% of his passes on the season, but for 1,871 yards and 13 touchdowns - he has six interceptions, while rushing for 23 yards on 12 attempts. Rodgers has been a solid fantasy option this season. Coming off his bye week and…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers throws for 172 yards Sunday
items.s: Aaron Rodgers completed 13-of-25 passes for 172 yards with an interception in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns. Rodgers did not need to do much in Sunday's win as the ground game dominated for Pittsburgh. He had one big throw to Darnell Washington that went for 58 yards. His interception was on a dropped pass by D.K. Metcalf. The Steelers are on their bye next week.

items.h: Modest production in Week 8 win
items.s: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. Jaylen Warren spearheaded the Steelers' attack with 143 rushing yards and a touchdown, and backfield mate Rico Dowdle added 56 yards and a score of his own. When combined with a highly effective effort by Pittsburgh's defense, there wasn't much production required of Rodgers and the air attack after much busier games leading into Sunday. Rodgers finished with season-low figures in completions, pass attempts, completion percentage and passing yards while failing to throw a touchdown pass for the first time since Week 2, but he's highly likely to revert…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers A Low-End QB2 Against Cleveland
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers disappointed for fantasy purposes last week but will look to get back on track in a divisional bout with the Cleveland Browns in Week 8. While the Browns are surrendering the seventh-fewest fantasy points to opposing quarterbacks, Rodgers managed 299 passing yards and three touchdowns despite throwing two interceptions against Cleveland back in Week 4. This is a pivotal matchup with both AFC North teams sitting at 5-2 heading into Sunday, so Rodgers should be locked in for what projects to be a competitive game. That said, plenty of other fantasy options have more favorable matchups at the position. Fantasy managers can turn to Rodgers in a…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers is a Desperation QB Pickup for Week 8
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers is not a worthwhile bet as a fantasy contributor in Week 8 and beyond in a typical single-QB league. However, if you are in a 2-QB league or are pressed to find a bye week fill-in, Rodgers can be a useful fantasy asset. Rodgers has strung together a solid start to the season, throwing for 13 touchdowns in seven games (1.86 TDs/game), and has accumulated almost 1,700 passing yards. He is currently slotted in as QB18 in fantasy points per game headed into a Week 8 matchup against the Cleveland Browns. The Browns' Defense comes in with the eighth-fewest fantasy points allowed to opposing QBs per game, only allowing 15.5 per game. This is notable…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers quiet in win over Saints
items.s: Aaron Rodgers completed 19-of-30 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints. He also ran three times for six yards. Rodgers had been on a hot streak coming into this game, and the overseas trip did him in, snapping his streak of multi-touchdown games. It was an unfortunate outing for those who expected a few more fireworks in this matchup, but down games are part of the fantasy football experience.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers worth starting in fantasy despite lackluster performance
Limited production in Week 7 win
items.s: Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 passes and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints. He added six yards on three carries. The Steelers' offense relied heavily on its backfield in this one, as Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle combined for 36 touches and 223 scrimmage yards. Rodgers did produce the team's only TD of the day on a four-yard toss to Darnell Washington in the second quarter. The veteran QB will take a 13:5 TD:INT through seven games into a Week 8 clash with the Browns, who Rodgers threw three touchdowns and a season-high 299 yards against in Week 4.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers A Viable Fantasy Option Against Saints
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers ranks as the fantasy QB3 since Week 3 and gets another favorable matchup against the New Orleans Saints in Week 7. New Orleans is allowing the eighth-most passing yards per contest and the most points per game to opposing offenses. While Pittsburgh's receiving corps is thin, Rodgers' chemistry with DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard was on full display in Week 6. There's little reason to think they can't pick up where they left off in Sunday's game in Paris. With several of the league's top fantasy quarterbacks on bye this week, Rodgers profiles as one of the best streaming options on the slate and can be started with confidence in most formats.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Remains a Viable Waiver-Wire Streaming Option
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers continues to make a case for a waiver-wire pickup after Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over Tampa Bay. Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception, marking his fourth straight game with multiple touchdown passes. The veteran has thrown 12 touchdowns through six starts, providing consistent fantasy production over the past month despite offering little as a runner. Rodgers faces New Orleans in Week 7 and remains a viable streaming option for fantasy managers seeking quarterback help, although his limited rushing upside caps his ceiling.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers throws for 253 yards Sunday
items.s: Aaron Rodgers completed 33-of-49 passes for 253 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. Rodgers threw an interception early, but he was able to bounce back and lead the Steelers to an overtime win. He was able to connect 11 times with both DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard. He'll be in the streaming conversation next week against the Saints.

items.h: Leads comeback in OT win
items.s: Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers. Down 16-3 to begin the fourth quarter, Rodgers began the comeback with a five-yard TD pass to Darnell Washington before leading the Steelers on three straight field-goal drives. The veteran QB then put together a 12-play, 70-yard drive to begin OT that was capped with a six-yard score to Germie Bernard. Rodgers has tossed multiple touchdowns in four straight games, posting an 11:4 TD:INT over that stretch and giving him plenty of momentum heading into a Week 7 trip to Paris to face the Saints.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers Remains on Fantasy Radar in Week 6
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers has thrown three touchdown passes in three straight games and will look to maintain that streak in Week 6 against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Tampa Bay has been solid defensively so far this season, holding opposing quarterbacks to the ninth-fewest fantasy points per contest. The Buccaneers are also one of just seven teams allowing fewer than 300 yards of offense per game through five weeks. Given the difficult matchup and the fact that Pittsburgh is thin at wide receiver, with Michael Pittman Jr. (foot), Roman Wilson (finger), and Ben Skowronek (calf) all inactive, Rodgers isn't necessarily set up for success in this one. Nonetheless, Tampa Bay…

items.h: Aaron Rodgers has Intriguing Value Ahead of Week 6
items.s: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers has looked like a new man under center lately. Over the last three games, Rodgers has thrown for 826 passing yards with nine touchdowns and three interceptions. The 42-year-old carved up the Indianapolis Colts defense this past weekend. He'll now head into a Week 6 matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who have struggled to contain the passing attack. Who knows how long this is going to last, but fantasy managers should ride out the wave. Rodgers is looking like a safe streaming option against the Buccaneers in Week 6. He has played well enough to be viewed as a viable option for this upcoming weekend.

items.h: Aaron Rodgers tosses three touchdowns in win
items.s: Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 31 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns, also running once for six yards in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts on Sunday. Rodgers had himself a day against the struggling Colts defense, taking only a single sack and not throwing an interception. He has been on fire in the last few weeks, with three touchdowns in each of his last three games. He's a streamable option if the matchup is right, and that could be as soon as next week against the Buccaneers.

items.h: Rodgers completed 22 of 31 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns while adding six yards on his only carry in Sunday's 34-22 win over the Colts.
items.s: Jaylen Warren did all the work on Rodgers' first TD, an 80-yard dash down the sideline in the first quarter after the veteran QB dumped the ball off to avoid a sack. Rodgers was a little more in command on his other two scores, both of which went to Pat Freiermuth on a one-yard toss in the second quarter and a 17-yard strike in the fourth. It was Rodgers' third straight three-TD performance, and his 71.0 percent completion rate was his most efficient effort yet in 2026. He'll take a 10:4 TD:INT through five games into a Week 6 road trip to Tampa Bay.

items.h: Rodgers completed 22 of 40 passes for 299 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions in the Steelers' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Thursday. He also ran in a game-tying two-point conversion.
items.s: Rodgers' final line underscores the type of uneven night it was for the future Hall of Famer and the Steelers offense as a whole. He got started on the right foot by leading a marathon 17-play, 78-yard drive that consumed 9:48 on Pittsburgh's opening drive, one he capped off with a 12-yard touchdown shovel pass to Roman Wilson. Rodgers would go on to add 21- and three-yard scoring tosses in the fourth quarter to tight ends Darnell Washington and Pat Freiermuth, respectively, the latter which the 22-year veteran followed up with a game-tying two-point conversion quarterback sneak. However,…

items.h: Rodgers completed 19 of 34 passes for 292 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 10 yards in the Steelers' 30-27 win over the Bengals on Sunday.
items.s: After averaging just 5.2 yards per attempt while completing a sparse 59.5 percent of his passes over the first two games of the season, Rodgers begin clicking in Mike McCarthy's offense Sunday. The future Hall of Famer averaged 8.6 yards per attempt and had five completions of 22 yards or more while connecting with nine different pass catchers overall. Rodgers distributed the ball on his three touchdown passes as well, hitting Roman Wilson, Ben Skowronek and DK Metcalf from 38, 23 and six yards out, respectively. Rodgers' passing yardage total was a season high despite his completion total…

items.h: Rodgers completed 23 of 39 passes for 187 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Patriots. He also rushed once for five yards and fumbled twice, losing one.
items.s: Rodgers threw for just 84 yards on 22 first-half pass attempts as the Steelers took a 10-3 deficit into the locker room. Things didn't get any better after halftime, as Rodgers lost a fumble in the fourth quarter that was scooped up by New England's defense for a touchdown and added an interception on a ball that hit rookie receiver Germie Bernard in the hands. Bernard and DK Metcalf turned 17 combined targets into just 62 yards as Pittsburgh's passing game struggled against New England's stout secondary in the absence of starting wide receiver Michael Pittman (foot). Things may not get much…

items.h: Rodgers completed 24 of 40 passes for 221 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and added three carries for minus-3 yards in the Steelers' 20-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
items.s: Rodgers commemorated his first non-preseason game under Mike McCarthy since a divisional-round matchup against the 49ers back in January 2020 with some solid numbers in Sunday's low-scoring win. The future Hall of Famer didn't have to be overly aggressive against a Falcons team down to its third-string quarterback in Cooper Rush, but Rodgers spread the ball around to seven different targets and displayed strong chemistry with offseason addition Michael Pittman (3-58-0). The veteran signal-caller hit Pat Freiermuth for his one touchdown pass from six yards out early in the second quarter, and…
